decisions.reason: Because this 2024 machine extends the firm’s core automated precast line and there is no clear signal yet that it falls below aspiration levels, management would use available slack in a growing industry to keep it on the market while learning from early customer adoption.

Because the production analysis software is closely complementary to the firm’s integrated equipment-and-service offering and supports its strategic move toward future-ready automation, management would likely retain it unless later results show a clear and persistent shortfall versus aspirations.
